name: apiKey
label: API key
placeholder: Enter the Healthchecks.io project API key
help: Create a key under **Project Settings → API Access**. A read-only key covers everything except the ping log.

name: serverUrl
label: Server URL
help: Change only when connecting to a self-hosted Healthchecks instance.

pattern.message: Enter the full address of the Healthchecks instance, e.g. https://healthchecks.example.com

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to a self-hosted instance that uses a self-signed or private CA certificate.
